summary: Carmel is a web-based astronaut health monitoring and wellness platform designed to support crew members during long-duration space missions. It provides an integrated dashboard to monitor key health indicators, radiation exposure, space-related hazards, spacecraft environmental conditions, and physical and mental well-being. The platform also includes interactive games such as reflex tests and memory challenges, along with breathing exercises and wellness activities to encourage cognitive engagement and stress management. By combining health monitoring, environmental awareness and interactive wellness tools, Carmel aims to promote astronaut well-being, support mission readiness and contribute to safer human space exploration.
details: Carmel – Crew Health Companion is an interactive web-based platform designed to support astronaut health and wellness during space missions. It provides a centralized dashboard for monitoring health indicators, radiation exposure, space-related hazards, spacecraft environmental conditions, and physical and mental well-being. It also features interactive games, reflex tests, memory challenges, breathing exercises and stress-relief activities to encourage cognitive engagement and healthy routines. The project aims to improve health awareness, promote astronaut well-being and support safer long-duration space exploration. Its development focuses on an accessible interface, interactive user experience and the integration of multiple aspects of astronaut wellness. It was developed as a single-file HTML web application, with simulated data used to demonstrate its monitoring features. No physical sensors or external hardware are connected.
